summary: Build CMDB, asset register, and reconciliation skills in 5 days. Learn practical ITIL 4-aligned control methods and reporting tools.
lede: CMDB asset reconciliation compares discovery results with inventory records to identify missing, duplicate, or inconsistent items. For IT asset, configuration, and operations professionals, the course covers validating discovery data, setting exception rules, and mapping configuration item relationships and baselines. Practical exercises use asset registers and CMDB records to support accurate inventories, audit evidence, and change control.
audienceIntro: This course is built for professionals who manage IT assets, configuration records, and service data in live operational environments. It speaks directly to the roles that maintain inventories, resolve record conflicts, prepare audit evidence, and support change control across hardware, software, and cloud-managed assets.
prerequisites: Prerequisites required: working knowledge of IT operations, incident or change processes, and basic familiarity with asset inventories or CMDB concepts. You do not need coding skills to complete the course, but you should be comfortable reviewing spreadsheet-based records, service management reports, and configuration data exported from discovery tools. Experience with ITIL 4 service management, software licensing basics, or endpoint administration will help, especially when working through configuration baselines, reconciliation exercises, and reporting templates. Advanced implementation topics such as automation scripts and discovery workflow design are covered at an operational level, not as engineering training.
